frame_basis.basis: 24 floorplan r1 row-engine frames x 655983 um2 per lane set (incl. exp, Z, P.V, score SRAM, q), minus the shared row FIFO, plus one synthesised hub

unit_basis.basis: pre-layout synthesised SS units (prod, add7, mul6, exp_p LA7/LM7), register bit 0.42282 um2, SRAM 12314.21 um2; no utilisation/CTS/PDN

power.limit_source: IEEE EPS Heterogeneous Integration Roadmap, Chapter 20 Thermal, draft v0.9 (2026)
power.peak_note: each lane set occupies its own frames at the parent lane density: the in-phase peak (a PDN/IR load, tau 1.22 ms >> phase) is unchanged by VP

active_fraction.basis: each lane set runs its K/V phases once per verify step of 202590 cycles vs once per AR token of 202590

power.verdict: PASS single-user time-averaged vs 2.0 nominal and 1.0 conservative
power.sustained_note: a 100%-duty strip (aggregate saturation) still needs the r2 duty governor <= 0.483 or a measured MAC <= 1.92 pJ; VP does not change that bound (intensive)
